title: A scalar positivity floor coexists with very expensive coarse approximations
statement: Any private mixture/product of completed calls exp(-i*c*theta*F)*V reduces after memory trace to phi(c)=E exp(-2i*c*T), with exact target diamond error |phi(c)+i|. The9x9Toeplitz positivity argument gives B9=[cot(pi/18)-1]/8 overc in[1,8]. Implementations withinnu of this class inherit B9-nu. The sharp two-point B3 and weaker second-moment number remain distinct bounds. Coarse finite programs approach nonzero error ceilings: the improved exponential law tends to0.834771016680..., while a separate completely fixed program gives0.839494573... with m=15*2^90segments,duration15*2^60 and202absolute binary timing places. The improved rationaleta0.01example guarantees about0.840823 by its summed bound, so is not itself a below0.84 implementation. Neither the floor nor these programs settle arbitrary native unknown-gain control.
